Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 v_lov boolean;
BEGIN
if(:control_block.s_drive_id is not null) then
 begin
 SELECT distinct dr.drive_id
 INTO :control_block.s_drive_id
 FROM drives dr, drive_sponsors ds, sponsors s
 WHERE dr.chapter_id =:global.chapter_id 
 AND dr.drive_id = ds.drive_id
 AND dr.status = 'CNFRM'
 AND dr.drive_type = decode(:control_block.fixsite,'FIX','F', 'MOB', decode(dr.drive_type,'I','I','C','C','I'), dr.drive_type)
 AND dr.drive_date between :control_block.s_start_date and :control_block.s_end_date
 AND ds.sponsor_id = s.sponsor_id
 AND ( dr.drive_id = :control_block.s_drive_id
 or name like '%'||:control_block.s_drive_id||'%'
 );
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('11109');
 when others then
 v_lov := show_lov('lov_drive_id_control');
 IF NOT v_lov THEN
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 END IF;
 end;
end if;
END;

/******Schedule start , END, Travel**********/
BEGIN

 SELECT schedule_start_time, schedule_end_time, sch_travel_time,
 projected_show, projected_draw, location_id
 INTO :pickup_schedule.schedule_start_time, :pickup_schedule.schedule_end_time, :pickup_schedule.travel_time,
 :pickup_schedule.projected_show, :pickup_schedule.projected_draw, :pickup_schedule.location_id
 FROM drives
 WHERE drive_id = :pickup_schedule.drive_id
 AND drive_date = :pickup_schedule.drive_date
 AND status = 'CNFRM'
 AND chapter_id = :global.chapter_id ;
 
 
 EXCEPTION
 when no_data_found then
 NULL;
 END;
 
 
 Begin
 
 if :global.time_zone_enabled ='Y' then
 
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,:pickup_schedule.schedule_start_time,v_local_time);
 
 
 :pickup_schedule.schedule_start_time :=v_local_time;
 
 
 --:fixed_site_hours.s_slot_time := to_char(:fixed_site_hours.slot_time,'HH24:MI') ;
 else

 :pickup_schedule.schedule_start_time := sysdate;
 
 
 end if;
 
 
 if :global.time_zone_enabled ='Y' then
 
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,:pickup_schedule.schedule_end_time,v_local_time1);
 
 
 :pickup_schedule.schedule_end_time :=v_local_time1;
 
 --:fixed_site_hours.s_slot_time := to_char(:fixed_site_hours.slot_time,'HH24:MI') ;
 else

 :pickup_schedule.schedule_end_time := sysdate;
 
 
 end if;
End;
--message('1');pause;

/******Directions**********/
 BEGIN
 SELECT site_directions, address_id
 INTO :pickup_schedule.direction, :pickup_schedule.address_id
 FROM locations
 WHERE location_id = :pickup_schedule.location_id
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id ;
 EXCEPTION
 when no_data_found then null ;
 when others then handle_error ; check_package_failure ;
 END;
--message('3');pause;
 BEGIN
 SELECT InitCap(ad.street_name)||', '||InitCap(vcs.city)||', '||vcs.state, vcs.zip
 INTO :pickup_schedule.location_address, :pickup_schedule.zip
 FROM addresses ad, valid_city_state vcs
 WHERE ad.address_id = :pickup_schedule.address_id
 AND ad.usps_id = vcs.usps_id
 AND ad.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id ;
 EXCEPTION
 when no_data_found then null ;
 when others then handle_error ; check_package_failure ;
 END;
end if;
END;

 where_clause := ' nvl(drive_id,''X'') = nvl(:control_block.s_drive_id, nvl(drive_id,''X'')) '||

 ' and exists ( select drive_id from drives where chapter_id = :global.chapter_id '||

if :control_block.fixsite = 'MOB' then

elsif :control_block.fixsite = 'FIX' then

end if;
